headline: Screamer documentation corrected; PAL v2.00 remains fully code-matched
summary: Contributors now have corrected Screamer behavior notes: it retreats to its spawn point after diving and dies only when lethal damage depletes its health. This was a comment correction, with no gameplay change. PAL v2.00 remains at 100.00% matched code, or 3,713,096 of 3,713,096 bytes, and 5,116 of 5,116 functions; matched code compiles to exactly the original game's bytes.
highlights: PAL v2.00 data matching stands at 0.57%. The readability proposal #161 closed without merging.
New reports cover Linux visual glitches in OpenRAC 0.10.0 (#162), a surround-sound request (#163), launcher freezes on Kubuntu 26.04 LTS (#164) and disc extraction failure (#165).
